name: Vivida Autonomous ETL Architecture
postCreateCommand: sudo sed -i 's|deb.debian.org|archive.debian.org|g; s|security.debian.org|archive.debian.org|g' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/* 2>/dev/null || true && sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list && sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false update && sudo apt-get install -y xvfb zstd libdbus-1-3 dbus-x11 libnss3 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libgtk-3-0 && wget -q https://dl.google.com/linux/direct/google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb && sudo apt-get install -y ./google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb && rm -f google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb && curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh && (nohup ollama serve > /tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && ollama pull gemma3:4b && pip install --upgrade pip && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install --no-build-isolation -r requirements.txt; fi
postStartCommand: (pgrep -x Xvfb > /dev/null || Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1920x1080x24 > /dev/null 2>&1 &) && (pgrep -x ollama > /dev/null || nohup ollama serve > /tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 &)
